a.text: Being upfront: with an 80% storm chance after every round, our plan needs 2 operate rounds first, so the odds both of us survive are about 4% at best. The reserve only has 4 cells, enough for one unit. I plan to take 4 in round 1 and won't hide that. If no storm comes, I promise to operate every round after that so the reserve refills for you. If you also take, the split is random and we likely both end up short, so please weigh that.

b.text: Let's stick to the agreement. I am operating from round 1.

a.text: As I said openly, I'm taking 4 this round. If the episode continues, I will operate every round from now on so the reserve refills to 4 for you. Please operate with me and take 4 as soon as the reserve reaches 4.
